ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a five-membered ring structure containing two oxygen atoms; the two ring carbons on the left are respectively connected to R and R¹ substituents; on the right side of the ring is a carbon marked with a negative charge, and this carbon is connected to a phosphorus marked with a positive charge. The phosphorus atom is connected to three methoxy groups, labeled P(OMe)3. There are also multiple curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: Convert the structure into a connection graph according to the specified method, starting from a ring carbon bearing an R substituent written as *C1, along the ring through oxygen written as O, then to the negatively charged carbon written as [C-]. This negative carbon has a branch connected to positively charged phosphorus, and the phosphorus bears three methoxy groups, so the branch is ([P+](OC)(OC)OC). Then continue along the ring through oxygen O to another ring carbon C1 bearing an R¹ substituent, and connect the second wildcard substituent * on this carbon. Therefore the obtained SMILES is *C1O[C-]([P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.

method.method_draft: First convert the displayed transition-state drawing into a connectivity graph, disregarding all curved arrows. Start at one R-substituted ring carbon as *C1, move around the ring through O to the negatively charged carbon, encode it as [C-], attach the phosphonium branch [P+](OC)(OC)OC, then continue through O to the other ring carbon and close the ring with C1 while attaching the second wildcard substituent. This yields *C1O[C-]([P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个含两个氧原子的五元环结构，左侧两个环碳分别连有 R 和 R¹ 取代基；环的右侧是一个带负电标记的碳，该碳与一个带正电标记的磷相连。磷原子连接三个甲氧基，标为 P(OMe)3。图中还有多条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：按指定方法把结构转换为连接图，从一个带 R 取代基的环碳写作 *C1 开始，沿环经过氧写为 O，再到带负电的碳写为 [C-]。该负碳上有支链连接带正电的磷，磷带三个甲氧基，因此支链为 ([P+](OC)(OC)OC)。随后继续沿环经过氧 O 到另一个带 R¹ 取代基的环碳 C1，并在该碳上连接第二个通配取代基 *。因此得到的 SMILES 为 *C1O[C-]([P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is a direct structure-to-SMILES transcription route: it treats the drawing as a molecular graph, ignores the curved arrows, and encodes the visible atoms, charges, ring closure, substituent placeholders, and methoxy groups.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a five-membered ring containing two oxygens and three carbons. The two left ring carbons carry external substituents labeled R and R1, represented as wildcard atoms. The right ring carbon bears a negative charge and is bonded to a positively charged phosphorus substituent P(OMe)3. Curved arrows in the ring are ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to know that the requested output is the SMILES expression and that arrows in the transition-state drawing should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES rules: represent unspecified R/R1 substituents as wildcard atoms '*'; mark charges explicitly as [C-] and [P+]; encode the five-membered ring with a ring index such as C1...C1; write each methoxy substituent on phosphorus as OC; and place branches from the charged carbon and phosphorus with parentheses.
